subject: general
question: The average age of 26 students of a class is 37 years. If the age of the teacher is also included, the average age of the whole group becomes 38 years. The age (in years) of the teacher is:
solution:
**Given:**

Average age of 26 students = 37 years

Average age of 27 people (including teacher) = 38 years

**Formula Used:**

Total age = Average × Number of people

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total age of 26 students = 37 × 26 = 962

⇒ Total age of 27 people = 38 × 27 = 1026

⇒ Age of the teacher = Total age of 27 people − Total age of 26 students

⇒ Age of the teacher = 1026 − 962 = 64

**∴ The correct answer is 64.**
